# Quality rules

<!-- Generated by `pnpm run docs:rules` from packages/qa/src/rules.ts and profiles/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every render is checked against these 26 rules. Each category weighs 20 points; the score /100 is the weighted share of compliant items over the rules that apply to the video (a rule with nothing to check, e.g. ducking without music, is *not evaluated* and excluded; the report shows the coverage).

Thresholds come from the style profile, never from code: the table shows each shipped profile's values. Override any of them in your own `.yaml` profile.

**Measured on** says what the check reads: *render* is an independent measurement of the delivered file; *EDL*, *render log* and *presets* verify the plan the renderer executed.

## Editing

### `montage.silences` — Silences > 350 ms removed, 80–120 ms margins

Weight **4** · measured on render + EDL

| Profile | Threshold |
|---|---|
| `short` | pause ≤ 350 ms; margins 80–120 ms |
| `long` | pause ≤ 350 ms; margins 80–120 ms |
| `cinematic` | pause ≤ 500 ms; margins 100–160 ms |
| `cinematic-short` | pause ≤ 400 ms; margins 90–140 ms |
| `tutorial` | pause ≤ 350 ms; margins 80–120 ms |

### `montage.fillers` — Hesitations and loud breaths removed

Weight **4** · measured on render

Threshold (all profiles): no audible hesitation or repetition

### `montage.beat-cuts` — Free cuts on the beat (±1 frame)

Weight **3** · measured on EDL

Threshold (all profiles): free cut within ±1 frame of a beat

### `montage.jl-cuts` — J/L cuts of 4 to 12 frames

Weight **2** · measured on EDL

Threshold (all profiles): 4–12 frames

### `montage.static-shots` — No static shot too long

Weight **4** · measured on EDL

| Profile | Threshold |
|---|---|
| `short` | static shot ≤ 4 s |
| `long` | static shot ≤ 8 s |
| `cinematic` | static shot ≤ 10 s |
| `cinematic-short` | static shot ≤ 6 s |
| `tutorial` | static shot ≤ 12 s |

### `montage.punch-ins` — Punch-ins 105–115 %, never twice at the same level

Weight **3** · measured on EDL

| Profile | Threshold |
|---|---|
| `short` | 105–115 %, never twice the same level |
| `long` | 105–115 %, never twice the same level |
| `cinematic` | 104–112 %, never twice the same level |
| `cinematic-short` | 104–112 %, never twice the same level |
| `tutorial` | 105–115 %, never twice the same level |

## Motion

### `motion.no-linear` — No linear interpolation (position, scale, opacity)

Weight **6** · measured on presets + EDL

Threshold (all profiles): no linear segment (position, scale, opacity)

### `motion.durations` — Micro-animations 150–300 ms, transitions 200–500 ms

Weight **4** · measured on presets + EDL

Threshold (all profiles): micro 150–300 ms; transitions 200–500 ms; dissolves 400–1500 ms

### `motion.blur` — Motion blur above the speed threshold

Weight **4** · measured on render log

Threshold (all profiles): blur above 12 px/frame

### `motion.overshoot` — Pop-in overshoot between 3 and 8 %

Weight **2** · measured on presets + EDL

Threshold (all profiles): overshoot 3 %–8 % (entrances, micro)

### `motion.presets` — Named, versioned and compliant presets

Weight **4** · measured on presets + EDL

Threshold (all profiles): named, versioned, compliant

## Captions

### `captions.sync` — Captions synced to the word

Weight **7** · measured on render

Threshold (all profiles): p95 offset ≤ 1 frame, max ≤ 3

### `captions.density` — Words per screen / lines / characters

Weight **4** · measured on EDL

| Profile | Threshold |
|---|---|
| `short` | 1–3 words per screen |
| `long` | ≤ 2 lines × 32 chars |
| `cinematic` | ≤ 2 lines × 38 chars |
| `cinematic-short` | 2–4 words per screen |
| `tutorial` | ≤ 2 lines × 32 chars |

### `captions.safe-zones` — Platform safe zones respected

Weight **5** · measured on EDL

| Profile | Threshold |
|---|---|
| `short` | inside tiktok ∩ reels ∩ shorts |
| `long` | inside title-safe |
| `cinematic` | inside title-safe |
| `cinematic-short` | inside tiktok ∩ reels ∩ shorts |
| `tutorial` | inside title-safe |

### `captions.contrast` — WCAG contrast ≥ 4.5:1

Weight **4** · measured on render + EDL

Threshold (all profiles): ≥ 4.5:1

## Audio

### `audio.loudness` — -14 LUFS ±1, true peak ≤ -1 dBTP

Weight **7** · measured on render

Threshold (all profiles): -14 ±1 LUFS ; TP ≤ -1 dBTP

### `audio.ducking` — Music ducked -12 to -18 dB, no pumping

Weight **5** · measured on render

Threshold (all profiles): music -12 to -18 dB under the voice, no pumping

### `audio.sfx-sync` — SFX in sync (±1 frame)

Weight **4** · measured on render + EDL

Threshold (all profiles): impact within ±1 frame

### `audio.cut-clicks` — No clicks at cuts (5–10 ms fades)

Weight **4** · measured on render + EDL

Threshold (all profiles): fades 5–10 ms, no click

## Image

### `image.reframe` — 9:16 reframing follows the subject smoothly

Weight **5** · measured on render + EDL

Threshold (all profiles): face ≥ 95 % in frame, centre ≤ 25 %; acceleration ≤ 3 px/frame²

### `image.color` — Consistent grading between shots

Weight **5** · measured on render

Threshold (all profiles): skin ΔL* ≤ 6, Δa*b* ≤ 6; one look

### `image.sharpness` — Sharpness: no picture enlarged beyond the limit

Weight **2** · measured on EDL

| Profile | Threshold |
|---|---|
| `short` | enlargement ≤ ×2.2 |
| `long` | enlargement ≤ ×2.2 |
| `cinematic` | enlargement ≤ ×2 |
| `cinematic-short` | enlargement ≤ ×2 |
| `tutorial` | enlargement ≤ ×2.2 |

### `image.export-format` — H.264/H.265, constant 30 or 60 fps, right resolution

Weight **2** · measured on render

| Profile | Threshold |
|---|---|
| `short` | H.264/H.265, 30 or 60 fps CFR |
| `long` | H.264/H.265, 30 or 60 fps CFR |
| `cinematic` | H.264/H.265, 24 or 25 or 30 or 60 fps CFR |
| `cinematic-short` | H.264/H.265, 24 or 25 or 30 or 60 fps CFR |
| `tutorial` | H.264/H.265, 30 or 60 fps CFR |

### `image.bitrate` — Video bitrate above the minimum

Weight **2** · measured on render

Threshold (all profiles): ≥ 16 Mbps (≤ 30 fps), 24 (60 fps)

### `image.black-frames` — No unplanned black frames

Weight **2** · measured on render

Threshold (all profiles): no unplanned black frame

### `image.duplicate-frames` — No unplanned duplicate frames

Weight **2** · measured on render

Threshold (all profiles): no frozen picture while the source moves
